description: Slices with the BambuStudio CLI and reports real statistics: layer count, print time, filament weight. Presets are flattened before they are passed to the CLI; feeding the raw presets to the CLI makes every inherited parameter fall back to the built-in default (BambuStudio#1704), so do not call the CLI directly. After slicing, it reads the settings that actually took effect back from the output and audits each override you requested; an overrideAudit entry with honoured = false was not applied. Starts a child process and writes a .gcode.3mf to the configured output directory. It does not send anything to a printer or start a print.

modelPath.description: Absolute path to the model file; it must be inside an allowed model directory.

overrides.description: Parameters to override; each key is a BambuStudio setting name (e.g. layer_height, sparse_infill_density).

reportSettings.description: Read back the values these parameters actually took in the output. Use it to confirm the slice really used the preset values rather than the slicer's built-in defaults.

name: bambu_slice

appliedSettings.description: The actual values in the output of the parameters requested by reportSettings.

filamentBreakdown.description: Usage per colour for multi-colour prints; omitted for single-colour prints.

filamentGrams.description: Total for the whole plate (including filament-change flushing and the prime tower); for multi-colour prints, the sum of all colours.

filamentLengthMm.description: Total for the whole plate; for multi-colour prints, the sum of all colours.

title: Slice (after flattening the inheritance chain)
